subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add a core opt-in delivery policy that coalesces or defers tool-interleaved assistant text across a whole agent turn, and what should the config shape be?
rationale: The source-backed problem is real, but the requested fix adds channel delivery policy and configuration surface, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add opt-in core coalescing policy
options.body: Define a narrow agents/channel delivery mode that preserves metadata and coalesces text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

options.title: Keep existing delivery boundaries
options.body: Close or defer the request if maintainers want tool-start/message boundaries to remain visible and avoid new config surface.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in core coalescing policy
recommendation.body: Define a narrow agents/channel delivery mode that preserves metadata and coalesces text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current-main author/merger for the central reply pipeline files and the strongest available owner signal for this product decision.
